messages:
maria: quick sync 	1:30am PT 	we need to finalize AWS/GCP/Azure packaging + legal checklist for marketplace onboarding. target: publish staging offers by EOD Friday. uploaded SKU sheet + trial flow: https://drive.redwood/marketplace-packages :eyes:
aj: saw it. question 	do we need separate SKUs per region or one SKU with entitlements?
kevin: partners prefer regionized billing in EU. can add region suffixes but prefer metadata tags to avoid SKU sprawl.
sarah: analytics side prefers one storefront SKU mapped to a trial entitlement so metrics are consolidated. can we map instead?
maria: prefer minimal SKUs. kevin 	please add region tags in metadata but keep single storefront SKU.
kevin: will do. sample manifest snippet i plan to push:
```
{"sku":"REDWD-INF-BASE","metadata":{"regions":"us,eu,apac","trial":"REDWD-INF-TRIAL","image_tag":"marketplace-v1.2.0"}}
```
legal-team: flagged EULA localization and data residency for DE/FR. also KMS ownership language for Private installs. added comments in doc.
maria: legal 	priority items?
legal-team: 1) KMS customer-managed only for Private, 2) telemetry opt-out text, 3) localized EULA for DE/FR and EN-GB.
aj: KMS text 	we'll reference customer-managed keys for Private, and Redwood-managed keys for Hosted/Dedicated. i'll add wording.
kevin: will push asset manifest + AMI/container digests into repo. PR after metadata edits.
azure-bot: manifest CI passed 	artifacts built 	digest: sha256:efgh5678
sarah: need rollback playbook for each marketplace: unpublish, revoke trials, rotate creds, notify customers, update docs. someone draft?
maria: @aj please draft AWS + Azure rollback steps; i'll draft GCP. keep it 6 steps max for support.
aj: on it. i'll strip down staging runbook and post.
kevin: metadata + manifest edits done in my branch; will PR now.
maria: timeline recap: kevin PR, legal snippets, aj rollback, sarah trial mapping. check back in 90 minutes. :thumbsup:
aj: noted.
legal-team: will post EULA snippets by EOD and ping here if any other requests.
sarah: prepping telemetry dashboards to validate trial conversions once staging is live.
maria: thanks all 	ping thread with blockers or when done.
